headline: Pakistani Rupee Closes Slightly Higher Against US Dollar at 276.56
summary: The Pakistani rupee gained Re0.01 to settle at 276.56 per US dollar in interbank trading as global dollar indexes touched 19-month highs.
why: The stability of the Pakistani rupee impacts external debt servicing and foreign currency reserves in South Asia.

impacts.name: Pakistani Rupee
impacts.why: Local currency edged up marginally against the US dollar.
